title: X is rolling out a redesigned web app country by country for signed-in users, with a single unified server, saying it improves load times over slow connections (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: X is rolling out a redesigned web app country by country for signed-in users, with a single unified server, saying it improves load times over slow connections — X is moving signed-in users to its new web app one country at a time, but it's already using the rewrite for X's logged-out web experience.
